full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
1945, August 30
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y.
August 30th 1945
Mrs. Alice Plunkett Detroit, Michigan
God bless you Mrs. Plunkett - Grandma Plunkett, - you and your crowd.
Please say a prayer that I may catch up with the correspondence.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. P.S. Many thanks for favor just noted.
Original in possession of:
Miss Esther Plunkett
20505 Charleston
Detroit, Michigan 48203
